description: Polgahawela Pradeshiya Sabha - Declared as Road and Lanes Owned by the Polgahawela Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notification deals specifically with land and property matters - the declaration of roads and lanes as owned by the Polgahawela Pradeshiya Sabha. It includes detailed schedules of specific roads with coordinates, lengths, and widths, and addresses land ownership claims and legal procedures related to property rights. The content focuses entirely on land administration, property boundaries, and ownership declarations, which falls under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
